Annotation.String: Dell OEM extension for OperationPrivilege providing payload-based privilege matching.
This complex type provides Dell OEM extension for the DMTF OperationPrivilege type, enabling payload-based privilege matching for action requests.
Initial release with PayloadMatchRules support for action-based privilege overrides.
Dell OEM extension for OperationPrivilege with payload matching.
This type provides Dell OEM extension for OperationPrivilege with payload-based privilege matching rules.
Rules for matching request payload properties to determine privilege requirements.

This property shall contain rules for matching request payload properties. An empty object indicates a default entry that matches any payload not caught by specific rules. Non-empty rules apply only if all specified conditions match (AND logic).
A set of payload property matching rules.

This type shall contain payload property matching rules. Each property name in this object corresponds to a property in the action request payload, and its value specifies the matching criteria. An empty object indicates a default entry that matches any payload.
Matching criteria for a single payload property.
This type shall contain the matching criteria for a single payload property. Exactly one match operator should be specified.
Matches if the payload property value exactly equals this value.
This property shall contain the exact value to match against the payload property. The match succeeds if the payload property value equals this value.
Matches if the payload property value equals any value in this array.
This property shall contain an array of allowed values. The match succeeds if the payload property value equals any value in this array.
Matches if the payload property value matches this regular expression pattern.
This property shall contain a regular expression pattern. The match succeeds if the payload property value (converted to string) matches this pattern.
Matches if the payload property value matches any of the specified Redfish URI templates.

This property shall contain an array of Redfish URI templates in OpenAPI format (e.g., '/redfish/v1/Managers/{ManagerId}/NetworkProtocol/HTTPS/Certificates/{CertificateId}'). The match succeeds if the payload property value matches any of the URI patterns in the array.
Matches if the payload property value is within the specified range [min, max].
This property shall contain a two-element array [min, max]. The match succeeds if the payload property value is a number within this inclusive range.
Matches if the payload property value is greater than this number.
This property shall contain a number. The match succeeds if the payload property value is greater than this number.
Matches if the payload property value is greater than or equal to this number.
This property shall contain a number. The match succeeds if the payload property value is greater than or equal to this number.
Matches if the payload property value is less than this number.
This property shall contain a number. The match succeeds if the payload property value is less than this number.
Matches if the payload property value is less than or equal to this number.
This property shall contain a number. The match succeeds if the payload property value is less than or equal to this number.
Matches based on whether the payload property exists.
If true, the match succeeds if the payload property exists (regardless of value). If false, the match succeeds if the payload property does not exist.
Matches based on whether the payload property value is null.
If true, the match succeeds if the payload property value is null. If false, the match succeeds if the payload property value is not null.
